name: Pixelpulse2
description:
Pixelpulse2 is an open-source graphical user interface for hardware signal exploration and analysis. Built to interface with devices such as Analog Devices' ADALM1000, it functions as a multi-instrument oscilloscope, signal generator, and power supply monitor.

Features:
- Real-time multi-channel oscilloscope visualization and waveform capture
- Integrated arbitrary signal and function generator controls
- Voltage and current measurement modes for circuit diagnostics
- Interactive zooming, panning, and cursor measurements across signal plots
- Data logging and CSV export for hardware engineering and academic experimentation
